lines.zh: 我用手背撑着地走，指节很粗。
lines.en: I walk on my knuckles, and they are thick.
Branches snap against my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的毛很长，挂在身上像草。
lines.en: My long fur hangs like grass.
Dead leaves crumble to powder underfoot.

lines.zh: 我低着头，从藤蔓下面钻。
lines.en: I duck under the vines.

lines.zh: 我的气味很重，走在前面。
lines.en: My smell runs ahead of me.
I push a stand of bamboo aside.
I am slow, but I do not detour.

lines.zh: 我的背是弯的，很少直起来。
lines.en: My back is bent. It rarely straightens.
Leaves rustle all along my path.

lines.zh: 我在泥里留下一个拳印。
lines.en: I leave a fist print in the mud.
I stop and sniff a root.
I stand there, breathing rough.

lines.zh: 长臂垂着，指尖碰到地面。
lines.en: My long arms hang; fingertips touch the ground.
Flies circle me.
There is mud and bark in my fur.

lines.zh: 我抓了抓胸口，声音很闷。
lines.en: I scratch my chest with a dull sound.
I cannot see far. I rely on smell.

lines.zh: 林子很静，除了我的呼吸。
lines.en: The wood is silent but for my breathing.
I press one hand to a tree.

lines.zh: 树干在我掌下弯了一点。
lines.en: The trunk bends a little under my palm.
I open my mouth; my teeth are yellow.
My stomach growls, loudly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转着身子，找方向。
lines.en: I turn slowly, getting my bearings.

lines.zh: 我的影子把地面盖住一块。
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 有虫落到我手臂上，我没拍。
lines.en: A bug lands on my arm. I do not brush it off.
You are too short. I must bend down.
My nose moves above your head.

lines.zh: 雨林里，你身上的味道太新。
lines.en: In this rainforest, your scent is too new.
I do not know your kind.
I shift a step; you shrink a step.
That is right. Further back.

lines.zh: 我用手背碰了碰你的肩。
lines.en: I touch your shoulder with the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 你站着，还不到我的膝盖。
lines.en: Standing, you barely reach my knee.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，是打招呼。
lines.en: I growl once. It is a greeting.
You cannot tell. I know.
I turn my back to you.
That means I do not mean to fight.

lines.zh: 传说里，我的嘴长在肚子上。
lines.en: In the legend, my mouth sits on my belly.
Come from that side, where I can see.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，等你的下一步。
lines.en: I stand still and wait for your next step.

lines.zh: 你一挪，我的长臂就抬起。
lines.en: You shift, and my long arm lifts.
Only shifted my feet.
I am slow. You need not worry.

lines.zh: 我闷叫了一声，退了半步。
lines.en: I grunt and give half a step.
I press a hand to the wound.
Blood matts my fur, heavy.

lines.zh: 传说的毛皮，比传说更厚。
lines.en: Legendary hide, thicker than the legend.
My breathing comes in bursts.
I put my back against a tree.
The tree creaks under me.
I look down at myself.
Vines wrap the wound; I straighten up.
I raise a hand, ready to answer.
Can that be eaten?

lines.zh: 我低下头，鼻子几乎碰到。
lines.en: I lower my head until my nose nearly touches it.
Too small. One bite and it is gone.
I reach out, very slowly.
You step back, and I stop.
I do not snatch from you.
Set it down and I will take it.
It chews like bark.
In the end I ate it.
Not enough to fill a tooth gap.
You hit me like a bank of earth.

lines.zh: 我没有动，你自己弹开了。
lines.en: I did not move. You rebounded.
I put a hand out and steady you.
My palm is wider than your face.
I step back and the ground moves.
Do not stand in front of my feet.
I lift a foot and step over you.
That was quite close.

lines.zh: 我的长臂从你头顶掠过。
lines.en: My long arm sweeps over your head.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气吹起你的头发。
lines.en: My breath lifts your hair.

lines.zh: 林子里还有另一个味道。
lines.en: There is another scent in the wood.
I walk that way.
She is large too, her fur longer than mine.
We touch noses.
I rake the bark so she hears it.

lines.zh: 我们一起拱开一片竹子。
lines.en: Together we push a stand of bamboo apart.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛厚，靠得近也不怕。
lines.en: My hide is thick. Come close.

lines.zh: 这条路会一直走到河边。
lines.en: This path leads to the river.
We are still walking after dark.
The wood is big enough for us both.
I scoop it up in my palm.
So light I barely felt it.
I bring it to my nose and sniff.
Not food. I put it down.
I open my hand; only wood dust remains.
I hold it out to you.
You reach for it; I wait.
It is too small for me to see.

lines.zh: 我把它放在树根上，森林会收下。
lines.en: I set it on the roots; the forest will keep it.
I will pass here again.
Something is on my path.
I raise my head and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 这气味陌生，我停下脚步。
lines.en: The scent is strange; I stop walking.
I put both hands to the ground.
My shoulders have hunched.
This wood is mine.

lines.zh: 我的毛长垂着，像挂了一身草。
lines.en: My long hair hangs like a coat of grass.

lines.zh: 我的吼声从胸口滚过雨林。
lines.en: My growl rolls through the rainforest from my chest.
It did not stop at all.

lines.zh: 我的气味先罩过去，你的脚会软。
lines.en: My stench goes first; your knees will weaken.

lines.zh: 脚掌压下，地面凹了一块。
lines.en: My foot lands and the ground dents.
The ground shakes once.
At last it sees me.
It is too late now.

lines.zh: 树被撞开，我加速冲过去。
lines.en: Trees snap aside as I charge.

lines.zh: 轮到我把爪子亮出来了。
lines.en: My turn to show the claws.
I walk toward it, unhurried.
It hides behind a tree. The tree is too small.
I push the tree aside.
It bolts away.
My legs are short, but my stride is long.

lines.zh: 它绕了一圈，还在我前面。
lines.en: It circles and is still ahead of me.
I can smell its sweat.
It is panting fast.
I drop both hands.
I run faster this way.
I break two trees running through.
It glances back.
That glance slows it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮着树皮，一路过来。
lines.en: My claws scraped bark the whole way here.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸吹动你背后的叶子。
lines.en: My breath stirs the leaves behind you.
It trips on a root.
I stop above it.
It no longer moves.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，土都翻起来。
lines.en: I bring a palm down and earth bursts up.
It is driven into the leaf litter.
I seize it and lift it.

lines.zh: 我的手指几乎圈住它整个身子。
lines.en: My fingers nearly close around its whole body.
I slam it into the ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪子，刨开了雨林的土。
lines.en: My claws tore the rainforest soil.
I growl and my chest shakes.
The sound carries far.
My second claw comes down after.
This one will be heavier.
It still tries to crawl away.
I set my foot in front of it.
It moves no more.
I bend down and look at it.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸吹得叶子乱飞。
lines.en: My breath sends leaves flying.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扫过，藤蔓全断了。
lines.en: My claws sweep; the vines snap.
I rise from deep in the wood.

lines.zh: 我身上的土一块块掉下来。
lines.en: Clods of earth fall off me.
This place smells unfamiliar.
I lift my head and scent a long while.
People, and other things.

lines.zh: 我用手背撑地，走了两步。
lines.en: I walk two steps on my knuckles.
The trees reach only my chest.

lines.zh: 我把一根藤从肩上扯下来。
lines.en: I pull a vine off my shoulder.
The sun is bright. I squint.
This wood is large enough.

lines.zh: 我在找一块能睡的地方。
lines.en: I am looking for somewhere to sleep.

lines.zh: 先得知道这里谁说了算。
lines.en: First I must learn who holds this place.
I work my way downhill.
The mud is soft. Right for my feet.
I let out a long breath.
This place will learn my smell.
I walk on.
The wood is perfectly still.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，焦味很重，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; the stink is thick. Two slaps.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，砸进一丛竹子。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and crash into bamboo.

lines.zh: 水没到我的下巴，我蹬着往岸上挣。
lines.en: Water reaches my jaw; I kick for the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推倒，我压断了两棵树。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and I break two trees.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的肩膀，很深。
lines.en: An arrow sinks deep into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 怪力压在我背上，我直不起身。
lines.en: Strange force bears on my back and I cannot rise.
Too long hungry; my legs tremble.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我整片毛都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and patches of fur burn.

lines.zh: 林子的地没了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The forest floor is gone and I fall.
